interaction.hands_full: You carry %s. Put it back where you took it to free your hands.
view.intro:
The scroll lies restored, as Lepsius drew it.

Walk [b]right to left[/b] with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. Click a figure or caption to walk up to it and read its description. Open the Journal with [j].
walk.start: Walk left along the scroll. Click anything drawn to read about it, or open the Journal to see what you have read.
walk.explore: Walk with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. Figures glow under the pointer; click one to read about it. The whole scroll is open to explore.
view.start: The scroll lies restored. Walk it and read what is drawn.
view.hint: Nothing here needs doing. Walk the scroll and click any figure or caption to read about it.
